reviewed_by: Claude general-purpose subagent, blind judgment reviewer (packet-only: competency text + rendered samples, no generator source), 2026-07-27 re-review batch

samples_reviewed.question_text: Write the symbol for the seventh position.
Write the symbol for the eighth position.

competency_fulfillment.rationale: Seeds 42-46 are numeral-to-word translation drills ('Which word describes the 7th position?', 'Write the symbol for the eighth position.'); not one sample places an object anywhere - no line of children, no shelf, no race - so the competency's noun phrase 'position of objects' is never exercised.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: Across all five seeds only the 7th and 8th ordinals are ever keyed (seventh, eighth, 7th, 8th); 1st through 6th and 9th through 20th never appear as targets, and the upper half of the stated range is touched only by distractors such as 'eleventh' and '14th'.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: Stems are single clauses of six to eight words using grade-2 vocabulary ('word', 'symbol', 'position'), and the task is one-step recall of a single ordinal name, which is well within a Grade 2 Quarter 1 reading and reasoning load.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: Only two templates exist - word given the symbol, and symbol given the word. There is no ordering-from-the-left/right item, no 'who is 3rd in line', and no identification of a named object's place in a pictured row, which are the natural contextual variants here.

competency_alignment.rationale: All five seeds sit at the identical trivial-recall level around 7th/8th, so the set shows no progression from small ordinals toward the 20th ceiling, and no progression from naming an ordinal to applying it to describe where something sits.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: The competency ceiling is 20th but the largest keyed ordinal in the packet is 8th; the only values approaching the ceiling ('fourteenth' in seed 43, '14th' in seed 44) are wrong options, so the stated range is never actually reached by a correct answer.
